newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CAPE TOWN TRAILING ROME, ATHENS IN OLYMPIC STAKES.
newsitem.headline: CAPE TOWN TRAILING ROME, ATHENS IN OLYMPIC STAKES.

text.p: Rome is odds-on favourite to win the right to host the 2004 Olympic Games, ahead of Athens and Cape Town, according to the latest odds quoted by U.K. bookmakers William Hill.
The organisation is quoting odds of 4-7 on for Rome, 11-4 against for Athens and 4-1 against for Cape Town in third place.
The two other cities in the shortlist of five, Stockholm and Buenos Aires, are rated outsiders at 7-1 and 14-1 respectively.
The winner will be selected in Lausanne, Switzerland, on September 5.
A Reuters survey of Olympic sports federations, sponsors and sports journalists earlier this month predicted the International Olympic Committee would choose Rome.
